stdinScript:
set +e
run() { printf '\n=== '; printf '%q ' "$@"; echo '==='; date -u --iso-8601=seconds; "$@"; rc=$?; echo "exitCode=$rc"; }
run swanctl --list-sas
run ip route get 10.244.1.4 from 10.246.1.1
trace=$(mktemp /tmp/vnbgp-reach-XXXXXX)
timeout 14 tcpdump -n -l -i any '(host 10.246.1.1 and host 10.244.1.4) or (udp port 4500 and (host 10.244.255.4 or host 10.244.255.5))' >"$trace" 2>&1 & capture=$!
sleep 1
run ping -I 10.246.1.1 -c 10 -i 0.5 -W 2 10.244.1.4
run python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(5); s.bind(("10.246.1.1",0)); s.connect(("10.244.1.4",22)); print("TCP22 PASS",s.getsockname(),s.getpeername()); s.close()'
wait "$capture"; echo "boundedCaptureExitCode=$? (124 is the expected capture timer)"
echo '=== Packet trace, cleartext workload on XFRM and UDP-encapsulated ESP on ens4 ==='
cat "$trace"
rm -f "$trace"
run swanctl --list-sas
run vtysh -c 'show bgp ipv4 unicast summary'
textNormalization: LF line endings; trailing spaces removed.
